messages:
samir: Heads-up — saw a ~12% p99 regression after the recent epilogue fusion change on the 8xA100 canary. Repro on local perfbench too.
maria: ugh. which change exactly? the bias+rope reorder from yesterday?
samir: yep that commit. stack: fused_epilogue_v2 + qkv_pack_agg. profiler snippet:
```
% Time  Cumulative  Self  Symbol
24.1   24.1        24.1  fused_epilogue_kernel
18.3   42.4        18.3  compute_attention_qkv_packed
11.2   53.6        11.2  kv_cache_lookup
...
```
samir: notice epilogue kernel dominated + higher kv cache stalls reported in traces.
drew: can you paste the batch shape distribution? might be hitting a different lane gating path with smallseq bursts.
anika: batch histogram from the run: 1,1,1,2,1,4,1,1,3,1 (median 1, 90pct 2). Small sequence heavy.
anika: I ran a microbench comparing the old epilogue vs fused_v2 for smallseq (bs=16, seq=8) — fused_v2 is ~15% slower. Attach quick config:
```
launch --kernel fused_v2 --threads 128 --lane-gate=auto --prefetch=on
launch --kernel fused_v1 --threads 128 --lane-gate=auto --prefetch=on
```
kevin: interesting. maybe the new fusion increases register pressure so L2 prefetch can't overlap kv reads for tiny seqs.
maria: that matches: the profiler shows higher L1 miss rate and increased stalls in 'ld.global' on the fused_v2 runs.
samir: do we have a fallback policy we can wire to avoid fused_v2 for tiny sequences? + how to detect at runtime cheaply.
drew: we already have a kernel chooser table keyed by (seq_len_bucket, batch_size_bucket, model_type). We could add a simple heuristic: if seq_len <= 16 and avg_batch_per_request <= 2 then prefer fused_v1 or the packed+epilogue separate path.
anika: I can add a quick sampling probe to the chooser: sample 0.1% of requests and run a perf counter compare, then update a moving-average score. Cheap — single cycle counter read.
kevin: rollout plan: add chooser heuristic behind a flag, enable on canary (10% of traffic) for two hours, collect p99 and kv miss metrics, then roll to 50% if improvement.
runtime-bot: deploy status: canary deploy started for tag epilogue-fix-chooser @ 3512350005 (10% traffic)
samir: thanks. also opened a tiny-regress bug: https://redwood/issue/INF-1229 with the profiler dumps and microbench results.
maria: one more thought — check bias+rope ordering: maybe bias addition before rotary leads to different memory access striding; try swapping order as A/B test.
dan: (react) :thumbsup:  
kevin: + note to SRE: watch GPU memory throughput and L2 utilization during canary window.
anika: I'll submit the chooser PR in 30m with tests and a small perf harness. Will include microbench artifacts.
samir: perfect. if we still see regressions we'll revert the fusion and iterate. Thanks all.
